label: Priority
note: A transparent priority rule, not a prediction. There is no outcome data, so no accuracy is claimed.

successor_status.label: Successor status
successor_status.note: A named permanent successor scores 0 whether internal or external.

company_exits.label: Other exits at the same company (last 12 months, this dataset)
company_exits.note: Counts other exit records for the same company whose filing date falls in the 365 days up to the as-of date. The record itself is not counted. OTHER events (moves, re-designations) are not exits.

timing.label: Timing of the effective date
timing.note: Days = effective date minus as-of date. 0 to 45 (today counts) scores 20; -30 to -1 scores 15; anything else, or no stated date, scores 5.

gate.effect: Applied after scoring: the seat is shown as filled and ranked below open seats.
